name: OpenAI
summary: ChatGPT’s reach, the economics of AI, and the challenge of turning adoption into durable profits.
overview: OpenAI has turned ChatGPT into a major distribution channel for artificial intelligence. The report separates the business it can monetize today from the much larger markets it hopes to reach through agents and future AI capabilities. That distinction matters when assessing how much growth a valuation already assumes.

bull_case: Consumer mindshare and developer adoption offer a path to a large platform business.
bear_case: The cost of intelligence, competitive model progress, and governance questions remain material.

intelligence.description: OpenAI develops ChatGPT and a model platform used by consumers, developers, and enterprises.
company: OpenAI turned ChatGPT into one of the largest consumer distribution channels in technology and continues to expand across API, enterprise, and agentic products.

Its March 2026 financing brought $122 billion in committed capital at an $852 billion post-money valuation. The capital supports the enormous compute and infrastructure investment required to keep improving and serving frontier models.
intelligence.why_it_matters: OpenAI is central to the private-market AI cycle and to public companies supplying compute, cloud capacity, chips, and enterprise distribution. Its eventual IPO would set a reference point for the economics and valuation of frontier AI.

changed.text: OpenAI is established as an AI research organization.
ChatGPT launches and creates a mass-market AI distribution channel.
Enterprise and developer adoption broaden beyond consumer chat.
A $122 billion financing funds the next phase of model and infrastructure expansion.

takeaways: ChatGPT's distribution creates a powerful platform advantage.
Compute intensity makes capital access a central competitive variable.
Enterprise adoption is critical to turning usage into durable economics.
IPO timing remains unconfirmed despite reported filing activity.
